payload.title: CMS-only hosts should serve the newsroom at / (newsroom.pilobol.us/newsroom is redundant)
payload.description: Ryan: why would we duplicate "newsroom" in newsroom.pilobol.us/newsroom? On a CMS-only host (Pilobol.us CMS app: Markus site, the host is only the editing UI) the newsroom should live at / . Papyrus supports brand.rootRoute {kind:"newsroom"} + newsroomBasePath "" (middleware.ts line ~17, lib/newsroom-base-path.ts, app/page.tsx; /newsroom redirects to /), but docs/standard-site.md says no browser sign-in flow was tested in that mode. Verify and fix every place that assumes /newsroom: staging gate redirect target (middleware.ts redirects anonymous staging requests to /newsroom), Cognito/Amplify OAuth return path (redirectUrls with /newsroom and /), sign-in/sign-out redirects, links, newsroomHref/getNewsroomNavHref, the Preview/staging flow, robots/noindex, bookmarks (/newsroom/* -> /*). Then switch the Pilobol.us scaffold brand to newsroomBasePath "" + rootRoute newsroom (PR into Pilobol.us main). Pretext sites that own / (Threat Intelligence, p.apyr.us) keep /newsroom: no change for them.
